title: Audit information and logging management need access protection evidence
remediation: The sponsor logging platform and privileged access owners protect audit records and tooling against unauthorized reading, modification and removal. Limit management to a named subset of privileged roles. Review representative access assignments and use controlled checks or dated evidence of protected operations, including a non-management role refusal.

milestones.title: Collect logging and record access policy, authorized privileged management scope and protected read, modification or removal evidence
